services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: At Waterfront Adventures: Swimming with the Manatees we have some of the best Kayaks and value on Kings Bay in the quaint little town of Crystal River, Florida. No waiting, no shuttles to busy public launches, private on the water parking, private launch, best equipment. Close to Three Sister’s Springs. We do have available some of the most durable, comfortable, adjustable, and tracking kayaks in the rental class. All of our kayaks are excellent quality and the finest you would find in a rental fleet. Discover the tranquility of solo exploration with our single kayak rentals, offering flexible Half-Day and Full-Day options. Whether you're seeking a brief escape or a full day of adventure,
